summary: Cardiol Therapeutics filed a Form 6-K attaching a US$75,000,000 Open Market Sale Agreement (a US at-the-market facility) with Jefferies LLC as sales agent, dated November 3, 2026. The company may sell common shares from time to time via placement notices, with a floor price no lower than US$1.00 absent agent consent, subject to a US$75 million maximum program amount. Proceeds are registered under the existing F-10 shelf. This is an ordinary equity distribution arrangement rather than a special situation; watch for periodic dilution and any drawdown disclosures.
